list_add.even: Add {k} to each integer in the list.
list_add.odd: Increase every integer in the list by {k}.

identity_prompts.train_list: Pass through the supplied integer list unchanged.
identity_prompts.calibration_scalar: Keep the given integer exactly as it is.
identity_prompts.calibration_list: Keep every integer in the given list as it is.

diagnostics.state_sample: the exact 128-float64 eligibility vector immediately before each emitted-token race
diagnostics.state_bytes: little-endian IEEE-754 float64 C-order bytes; exactly 1024 bytes per sample
diagnostics.first_decision_pair_set: all unordered TRAIN task pairs with the same typed result and different first teacher token
diagnostics.state_separation_aggregation: report count, minimum, p10, median, and mean separately for Int and List[Int] pairs
diagnostics.state_separation_hypothesis: A1 exceeds A0 at p10 and median in both type strata; diagnostic only and never an A2 veto
diagnostics.fading_pair_set: the final committed raw prompt byte of every TRAIN task paired with its first program-token decision
diagnostics.fading_aggregation: report the exact token-distance set plus count, minimum, p10, median, and mean retention separately for Int and List[Int] tasks
diagnostics.fading_hypothesis: A1 direct retention exceeds A0 at p10 and median in both type strata; diagnostic only and never an A2 veto
diagnostics.target_margin_pair_set: every competitive TRAIN teacher position in a sealed A2 exact-replay completion
diagnostics.target_margin_formula: current(expected target)-max current(other allowed target), in pA
diagnostics.target_margin_aggregation: report count, minimum, p10, median, and mean; minimum must be strictly positive

eligibility_gates.completion_phase: seal all A0, A1, and A2 TRAIN and calibration completions before any label, case, family, or template scoring
eligibility_gates.decision_collision: reject if exact eligibility bytes repeat for the same allowed-cell set at decisions with different expected targets
eligibility_gates.target_margin: all competitive TRAIN A2 target margins are finite and strictly positive

seed_creation_preconditions: A2 passes every frozen TRAIN and calibration capability and integrity gate
this protocol and its complete source bundle are committed and reviewed
a new public seed is generated once and anchored before any task bytes are materialized
no benchmark result or task label is used to choose, retry, repair, or resume the cohort

execution.runtime_backend: native CPU for all three 128-cell lanes; HUMANBRAIN_DEVICE=cuda is rejected
execution.runtime_binary_evidence: hash the exact loaded source-addressed native library after every lane and after all completions; require byte identity
execution.evidence_mode: exclusive create; refuse if the run directory or any evidence target exists
execution.failure_policy: preserve every partial artifact and terminal failure record
execution.resume_policy: no resume and no rerun under the same run identifier
execution.development_policy: DEV-v1 is retired and must never be rerun or used for tuning
execution.selection_policy: A0 and A1 are diagnostic only; A2 is the sole eligible lane; no winner selection among trained variants
execution.run_hold: No material TRAIN, calibration, or future-cohort execution is authorized by this protocol freeze.
